title: No source fixes the case-facts field list behind the D7.1 approval screen, the names of the two approval outcome events, the naming of the redress task, or the business date of the postal address input
source: Recovery Workbench Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 10, 42 and 44; Ownership Map v1 (api rows for P3 rwb-case, P1 rwb-source-data, P4 rwb-access and P7 rwb-decision); Recovery Workbench TSD P3 v3 section T3.1 (recovery_case, case_account, task, assignment) and T-A.2 (API-P3-002, API-P3-003); legacy story RWB-E2-014 sections 3, 4, 11 and 12
section: s3 Preconditions; s7 Acceptance criteria; s11 Data; s12.1 REST operations provided; s12.2 REST operations consumed; s12.4 Events consumed; s12.7 Tables owned; s12.8 Contract fakes
description: The slice serves the case facts panel of SCR-11 and turns a refused or returned notice into a task on the case, and four of its inputs have no published source. First, Architecture v5 slide 10 gives the case read as GET /v1/cases/{id} returning case, stage and tasks and the legacy story gives the facts the panel needs (case number, product, total balance with its business date, addressee role, masked postal address, rule and template version, preparer), but no source fixes the field list, the order or the type of the case-facts projection, and none fixes the inputAsOf element (inputCode, businessDate, ageDays) that carries each input's date and age to the panel; the legacy story also gives no field list for the input age at all. Second, the outcome of a decision reaches rwb-case as an event, and the catalogue gives ApprovalRequested and the decision record only, so the refusal and return events this story consumes have no name, key or payload. Third, the redress task needs a task code, an element type, an owner role, a due time and the notice and approval references, and TSD P3 v3 T3.1 gives the task table no column for the notice and no row for any of those values. Fourth, the postal address input's business date is the fact the panel shows, and no source says which field of the rwb-source-data customer read carries it or how the contact fact is dated, while the legacy story read it from v_ace_contact through the owning module's DTO.
evidence: Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slide 10: rwb-case GET /v1/cases/{id} returns case, stage and tasks, and each tab loads from its owner one hop; slide 42: event 08 DecisionRecorded, ApprovalRequested and the decision record are catalogued, no refusal or return event; slide 44: event and queue ownership per service; legacy RWB-E2-014 section 4 step 4 and AC10 name the facts shown but not their field list; section 12 gives NoticeApi methods and EV-13 and EV-08 only; section 11 reads DF-ACE-078 contact_value 'masked through the owning module's DTO' with no date field; TSD P3 v3 T3.1 task rows end at outcome_code with no notice or approval reference and no task code list; TSD P3 v3 T-A.2 API-P3-002 and API-P3-003 give purpose, request and response type names (Case, TimelinePage) with no field list; TSD P3 v3 T3.2 gives LOV-ELEMENT, LOV-TASK-STATUS, LOV-ROLE and LOV-ASSIGN-REASON as lists with no task-code list.
legacy_ref: RWB-E2-014 (AC1, AC2, AC3, AC5, AC10, X2, X3)
proposed: Fix the four shapes in the RWB-P7-E2014-CON and RWB-P3-E1043-CON baseline reviews: the case-facts projection with inputAsOf on API-P3-002, one refusal event and one return event on rwb.decision.events.v1 with their key and payload, the task code and its reference row with the notice and approval references, and the dated contact read on the rwb-source-data contract; until then this story carries the projection, the two event names, the task naming and the address date as stated in ASM-B2-P3-006-1 to ASM-B2-P3-006-4 and renames nothing in behaviour if the published shapes differ.
